revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 8.6% (61,160 vs 56,334); fade toward GDP-plus as Humira erosion is replaced by Skyrizi/Rinvoq and patent-cliff risk builds.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 24.6% (15,075/61,160), FY2023 23.5%; modest expansion as intangible amortization (7,377 in FY2025) declines and operating leverage; FY2024 depressed by IPR&D charges.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: below the 21% US statutory rate given AbbVie's international mix/Puerto Rico; Damodaran industry effective rate is 3.0% (too low for a conservative case).

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 D&A incl. intangible amortization 8,139/61,160 = 13.3%; slightly lower as acquired intangibles amortize.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 1.10 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = Ke 9.75%; beta = Damodaran Drugs unlevered cash-corrected 0.915 relevered at assumed market D/E 0.25 (no price in tool; assumption), tax 21%. Kd pre-tax 6.0% (Damodaran drugs 6.02%), after-tax 4.76%. Weights 80% E / 20% D => 8.76%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and long-run nominal US GDP growth; mature pharma.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = total debt 67,496 (LT 58,941 + current 6,056 + ST borrowings 2,499) - cash 5,229 - ST investments 28; accession 0001551152-26-000008
